message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The passages collectively identify three clear risk examples from Airbnb's Risk Factors Summary: 1) COVID-19 pandemic impact on business, 2) persistent net losses and uncertain profitability, and 3) laws/regulations affecting short-term rentals/home sharing. Each required risk is explicitly described in the sources.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"COVID-19 pandemic impact on business, results of operations, and financial condition","passage_rank":2,"quote":"The COVID-19 pandemic and the impact of actions to mitigate the COVID-19 pandemic have materially adversely impacted and will continue to materially adversely impact our business, results of operations, and financial condition."},{"requirement":"Net losses and uncertainty about profitability","passage_rank":2,"quote":"We have incurred net losses in each year since inception, and we may not be able to achieve profitability."},{"requirement":"Laws, regulations and rules affecting short-term rental and home sharing","passage_rank":2,"quote":"Laws, regulations, and rules that affect the short-term rental and home sharing business may limit the ability or willingness of hosts to share their spaces over our platform and expose our hosts or us to significant penalties, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, and financial condition."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
